propositions: Project code-review criteria with non-empty applies_to are currently stored but never validated or read during dispatch, causing them to run on every review regardless of changed files
The applies_to field lacks shape validation at overlay load time, allowing malformed values to silently narrow to empty list and revert to always-on behavior instead of raising errors
Project criteria are appended to active_criteria only gated by ROUND_A, bypassing the workflow's membership gating and file-change predicates that built-in criteria respect
applies_to must be read from effective_routing for project criteria and matched against changed_files using glob matching, consistent with plan-review's project criteria gating pattern
An empty or absent applies_to for project criteria should remain always-on, while a non-empty applies_to should gate dispatch to only changed files matching the globs
